message: The last time the power went out, my kids thought it was the perfect excuse for a spontaneous campout in the living room. While I scrambled for flashlights and power banks, they set up their own little fort with pillows and blankets. Once I got everything sorted, we ended up having a cozy family night, complete with stories and snacks. It reminded me that even in the dark, we can find light in each other’s company. How do you keep the fun alive during a blackout?
